key_releases.name: Jobs report (Employment Situation)
key_releases.what: How many jobs the economy added last month and the unemployment rate. Published by the BLS, usually on the first Friday of the month at 8:30 AM ET.
key_releases.why: Strong jobs can mean a healthy economy but also fewer rate cuts. Weak jobs can spark recession worries. Both can move markets.

key_releases.name: CPI (Consumer Price Index)
key_releases.what: The most-watched inflation number: how fast everyday prices are rising. Published monthly by the BLS.
key_releases.why: Inflation above expectations tends to push interest rates (and pressure on stocks) higher. Below expectations often lifts stocks.

key_releases.name: PCE inflation
key_releases.what: The inflation gauge the Fed prefers, released with the BEA's personal income report.
key_releases.why: The Fed's 2% inflation target is measured with PCE, so this number directly shapes rate decisions.

key_releases.name: FOMC decision
key_releases.what: The Federal Reserve's committee meets eight times a year to set short-term interest rates.
key_releases.why: Rates affect borrowing costs everywhere and how much investors will pay for stocks. The words in the statement matter as much as the decision.

key_releases.name: GDP
key_releases.what: The total output of the US economy. Released quarterly in three estimates: advance, second and third.
key_releases.why: Shows if the economy is growing or shrinking, which drives company profit expectations.

key_releases.name: Retail sales and consumer spending
key_releases.what: How much shoppers spent last month. Published monthly by the Census Bureau.
key_releases.why: US consumers drive about two-thirds of the economy, so weak spending is an early warning.

key_releases.name: ISM / PMI surveys
key_releases.what: Monthly surveys of purchasing managers. A reading above 50 signals expansion, below 50 contraction.
key_releases.why: A fast, forward-looking read on business conditions.

notes: CPI and the jobs report come from the BLS, which blocks automated access, so their dates are not listed here. See bls.gov/schedule.
Dates and times can change. Always confirm with the official source before relying on a time.
